card.name: Space or digit before a number starting 1
card.fires_on: The space or partial digit just before a number that begins with 1 (such as 14, 13, 1200 or 1680). It appears in lists of numbers, dose tables and date ranges.

modes.label: Space before repeated number
modes.description: A blank before a number that echoes a nearby figure, like 14 generations or a dose.

modes.label: Digit inside a date
modes.description: A digit partway through a year or date range.

card.writes: It seems to push the next token toward a number starting with 1, and it favors October-type tokens over December and Christmas ones.
card.plain: It fires when the next thing is likely a number starting with 1, such as in a dose list or a count.
